title: Senex Creek / Senekes River
summary: Senex is recorded as a creek at Center Moriches, also called Senekes River or Creek.
activity_update_summary: Moved the 1693 survey detail into the cited Historic Moment and removed the repeated history paragraph.
translation_content:
Sinnekes may have been the name of a Native person who lived at the point or creek. The word is also compared with terms for a thorn or bush.

Why Place Names Matter

“Maps that employ Indigenous place names represent a recovery of language and tribal sovereignty.”

— University of Colorado Boulder Libraries, The World of Printed Maps: Indigenous place name maps (2023), opening text
preservation_content: Senex Creek preserves a Native name in the Moriches waterways, where creeks and points became central to survey, patent, and boundary records.
